EU Seeks to Rebalance Trade with China Post-Hybrid Car Deal

Following a deal on hybrid cars, the European Economic Commission has stated that the European Union needs to rebalance trade with China in other sectors. This development comes as Europe coalesces around a tougher stance on China, with reports indicating that China cannot afford to lose Europe as a trading partner amidst increasing trade barriers.
